records.name: ClassLink
records.description: Your district apps, in one place.
steps: Open the district ClassLink launchpad.
Sign in with your district-provided credentials.
Choose the learning app you need; contact campus support if access fails.

records.name: Grades & records
records.description: Find Home Access Center information and student-record guidance.
steps: Use the district HAC information page to reach the sign-in portal.
Review posted grades and available student information.
Contact your campus about account access or a record that needs correction.

records.name: Enrollment & school assignment
records.description: Find the campus assigned to your address.
steps: Use the official locator with your home address.
Review district registration requirements.
Contact the assigned campus for enrollment support; choice programs may require a separate application.

records.name: School meals
records.description: Menus, nutrition, and district meal information.
steps: Check the district meal information for the current school year.
Find menus and nutrition resources.
Contact food services or your campus about dietary accommodation procedures.

records.name: Transportation
steps: Check current transportation eligibility and route information.
Confirm pickup and drop-off details before the school day.
Use the district transportation contact for route questions.

records.name: District calendar
steps: Open the official calendar and select the appropriate school year.
Check holidays, student days, and district events.
Confirm campus-specific events on your school’s official website.

records.name: College readiness
records.description: Plan admission steps with district resources.
steps: Discuss your college goals with a counselor.
Build a list of colleges, programs, and application requirements.
Track admission, transcript, testing, and financial-aid tasks.

records.name: Financial aid
steps: Use the district guide to determine which application applies to you.
Gather the requested information using the official application instructions.
Ask your counselor about support and current graduation-related requirements.

records.name: Schools of choice
records.description: Compare programs and find application guidance.
steps: Explore the six district-listed choice entries in the school catalog.
Read the current district admissions requirements and application window.
Confirm program fit and any required steps with the choice office.

records.name: Counseling & student support
steps: Use the district counseling directory to find available services.
Contact your campus counselor for academic, college, career, or student-support questions.
For time-sensitive campus concerns, call your school directly.

records.name: College entrance testing
records.description: ACT, SAT, PSAT, and TSIA2 resources.
steps: Review the purpose of each assessment with your counselor.
Confirm testing dates, registration, and any fee-waiver eligibility.
Use the preparation resources linked by the district.

records.name: District student hub
records.description: A broader directory of student services.
steps: Browse the district’s official student links.
Use your school profile for campus-specific contacts.
Return to Xpress to keep exploring scholarships and pathways.
